libritts_unseen_quality.description: Paper-reported LibriTTS unseen-speaker quality metrics from Figure 2(g).

wer_percent.description: Inactive paper-context metric; the train/test artifact evaluators do not compute LibriTTS WER.

ssim.description: Inactive paper-context metric; the train/test artifact evaluators do not compute LibriTTS SSIM.

fd.description: Inactive paper-context metric; the train/test artifact evaluators do not compute LibriTTS Frechet distance.

utmosv2.description: Inactive paper-context metric; the train/test artifact evaluators do not compute LibriTTS UTMOSv2.

libritts_unseen_frame_stacking.description: Paper-reported LibriTTS unseen-speaker stack-factor-2 tradeoff from Figure 2(g) and Section 3.3. The parallel_2x throughput proxy is inferred from stack factor because the paper reports relative throughput for LT variants but not for the degraded parallel-stacked diagnostic.

ssim.description: Inactive paper-context metric; the train/test artifact evaluators do not compute LibriTTS SSIM.

fd.description: Inactive paper-context metric; the train/test artifact evaluators do not compute LibriTTS Frechet distance.

utmosv2.description: Inactive paper-context metric; the train/test artifact evaluators do not compute LibriTTS UTMOSv2.

relative_throughput.description: Inactive paper-context metric; the train/test artifact evaluators use stack-factor steps instead of hardware-dependent throughput.

synthetic_codec_unseen.description: Reproduction-gym replacement for the unreleased Koel-TTS/NanoCodec setup. Targets reflect the expected behavior on the fixed synthetic multi-codebook codec task: local-transformer methods should produce valid dependent codebook tuples with fewer primary steps under frame stacking.

token_accuracy.description: Exact-token accuracy on the evaluated half of the fixed synthetic codec test split.

dependency_validity.description: Fraction of dependent codebook entries satisfying the synthetic codec dependency rule.

codec_fd.description: Distributional distance between predicted and reference deterministic codec-frame embeddings.

speaker_conditioned_codec_fd.description: Average per-speaker codec embedding distance, added to catch methods that match global statistics while collapsing speaker structure.

primary_steps_per_24_frames.description: Machine-independent decoding-effort proxy derived from the artifact stack factor.
